name: pr-company-income-tax
description: Compute the Puerto Rico income tax of a regular corporation for a tax year beginning in 2026 under the Internal Revenue Code of 2011 as revised 28 May 2026. Covers which entities are regular corporations, the 18.5 percent normal tax on net income less the dividends deduction, the graduated surtax (5 to 19 percent) after the USD 25,000 surtax deduction and its split in a controlled group, the alternative minimum tax (greater of USD 500 or 18.5 percent, 23 percent for USD 10 million businesses, USD 50,000 exempt amount), the net operating loss carryforward (10 years, 90 percent of net income), the optional gross income tax for service corporations, the 20 percent alternative tax on long-term capital gains, the financial statement tiers (USD 1, 3 and 10 million), quarterly estimated tax over USD 1,000, and filing Form 480.20 electronically by 15 April with a 6-month extension (Form AS 2644) that requires full payment.
